snippet.title: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC – Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Pac-Man adventure you’ve been waiting for is finally here! The upbeat action and fun of PAC-MAN WORLD 2 is back and better than ever in PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC! Remade from scratch with the original recipe! Explore a world of fun and reclaim the Golden Fruit to save Pac-Land from the Ghosts and their boss, Spooky!

Adventure is back on the menu!
Available September 26th, 2025!
Buy now: https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/pac-man-world-2-re-pac
